categories.main_business_segments: The company operates through two primary service segments: (1) Urban Green Development Full-Process Technical Services, including city planning, architectural design, EPC and project management, and green construction operations; (2) Green Living Public Trust Full-Process Technical Services, including testing, inspection, certification, and technical consulting services. The company also provides research and development services related to green building and sustainable urban development.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include: ecological diagnosis and assessment methodologies, green building design optimization, light-storage-flexible (光储直柔) building direct current distribution systems, modular building products, digital platforms for energy management and building performance monitoring, and comprehensive testing and certification capabilities. The company operates through research-driven innovation, technical consulting, engineering design, project management, and third-party testing and verification services.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include government departments, state-owned enterprises, real estate developers, and municipal authorities. Key end markets are urban green development projects, green building certification and evaluation, building energy efficiency retrofitting, ecological city planning, and infrastructure safety assessment. The company serves customers in major Chinese cities including Shenzhen, Xiong'an New Area, and other regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in South China (Shenzhen and Guangdong Province region), North China (Xiong'an New Area and Beijing region), Central China (Hubei Province), Southwest China, East China, and emerging markets in South Asia. Major operating regions include Shenzhen as the core base, Xiong'an New Area as a strategic focus, and expanding presence in other provinces through subsidiary companies.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as a service provider across multiple points in the building and urban development value chain. It provides upstream services (planning, design, consulting), midstream services (project management, construction oversight), and downstream services (testing, inspection, certification, operations management). The company positions itself as an integrated full-process technical service provider rather than a traditional supply chain participant.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) advancing light-storage-flexible building technology and demonstration projects; (2) developing green retrofitting technologies for existing buildings; (3) building low-carbon resilient cities; (4) digital transformation and AI integration in building and urban management; (5) expanding green building certification and evaluation services; (6) developing energy management and operational services. The company maintains high R&D investment at approximately 11% of revenue.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through multiple streams: (1) professional services fees from planning, design, and consulting projects; (2) testing, inspection, and certification service fees; (3) project management and EPC contract revenues; (4) technical consulting and research services; (5) property rental income from investment properties. Revenue is primarily project-based with recognition upon service delivery and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading green city development technology service provider in China with differentiated competitive advantages. It competes with other architectural design firms, engineering consulting companies, and testing/certification organizations. The company's competitive strengths include 30 years of specialization in green building, proprietary technologies like light-storage-flexible systems, comprehensive full-process service capabilities, and strong brand recognition in sustainable development.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized professional services firm with 2024 revenue of approximately 372 million RMB, down 11.83% from 2023 (422 million RMB). Net profit attributable to shareholders was 2.4 million RMB in 2024 compared to 23.7 million RMB in 2023. Total assets reached 1.49 billion RMB at year-end 2024. The company has approximately 847 employees. Growth has moderated due to industry headwinds in construction and real estate sectors.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's unique value proposition centers on: (1) integrated full-process green development solutions combining planning, design, construction, and operations; (2) proprietary light-storage-flexible building technology for energy efficiency; (3) comprehensive testing and certification capabilities ensuring building performance; (4) 30-year expertise in green building and sustainable urban development; (5) research-driven innovation with 100+ patents and participation in national research programs; (6) focus on human-centric design addressing safety, health, comfort, and sustainability (五感六性 framework).
